name: Maghrib Arcade
summary: A stepped square minaret grows from the same foundation as a low domed prayer hall and three open arches.
why: The minaret and hall form one uninterrupted silhouette. All three arch openings land on the same foundation; the two hall arches mirror one another about the dome. Copper cornices sit directly on the architecture.
risk: The regional character is an invented interpretation. It favors a solid traditional profile over a delicate ornamental one.
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque that feels familiar, substantial, and carefully built.
